capabilities: insert countdown timer blocks via command palette
render live-updating countdowns in code blocks
edit target date, label, and colour with inline buttons
configure global defaults for label, duration, and colour
extras: Includes a Chinese README; UI strings and unit labels automatically localize to English or Chinese based on app language.
intentEvidence: Bring Feishu/Lark-style countdown blocks to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render live countdown timers inside notes.
summary: Countdown timer plugin that renders Feishu/Lark-style live-updating countdown blocks in code blocks, with inline editing and localized labels.
